title: Design
description:
A complete design: one theme and one viewport applied to an ordered
list of screens.

outline.description:
The screen titles of the complete design, in order. A preview design
lists more titles than it has screens: the app continues it from
this list later. Leave it empty when the design is complete.

theme.description: Visual identity applied to every screen.

title.description: Design title, shown in the editor and the session.

transition.description:
How the presentation moves from one screen to the next. Leave it
out for a design that scrolls instead of animating.

viewport.description:
The px canvas every screen is laid out on. Set it from the
brief's target platform: 1440 by 900 for desktop web, 390 by 844
for a phone, 1024 by 768 for a tablet. Absent means 1440 by 900.

body.description: Family for every other text element that sets no font.

heading.description: Family for text elements with role `title` or `heading`.

accent.description: Color for highlights, shapes, and chart series that set no color.

background.description: Screen background color when a screen sets no background.

muted.description: Secondary color for captions, rules, and table stripes.

text.description: Text color when an element sets no color.

Screen.description:
One screen: an HTML fragment for the design's viewport, CSS for
that fragment, a name, and notes.

css.description:
CSS for this screen only. The server scopes every selector to
this screen. Use plain selectors such as `.title` or `h1`. Use the
theme through `var(--background)`, `var(--text)`, `var(--accent)`,
`var(--muted)`, `var(--heading-font)`, `var(--body-font)`,
`var(--mono-font)`. No `@import`, no viewport units, no `<`.

html.description:
The screen as one HTML fragment. The canvas is the design's `viewport` in px; use px units. Allowed: headings, text, lists, tables, `` with `src="/uploads/{name}"`, inline `
`,

`, ``. Not allowed: `

name.description:
A short name for the screen, such as `Home` or `Checkout`. Shown
in the editor. Empty means the editor derives one from the html.

notes.description:
Design notes: intent, states, or handoff remarks. Never rendered
on the screen.

Theme.description:
Default colors and fonts that elements inherit when they omit their
own.

name.description: Theme name shown in the editor.

Transition.description: How the design moves from one screen to the next.

axis.description:
The direction the screens travel. Ignored by `none`, `fade`, and
`zoom`, which do not travel.

duration_ms.description:
How long one transition takes, in milliseconds. Use 0 to 3000.
Ignored by `none`, which always cuts.

effect.description: The visual effect between two screens.

oneOf.description: The next screen arrives from below.
The next screen arrives from the right.

TransitionEffect.description: The visual effect between two screens.

oneOf.description: The next screen replaces this one at once.

Both screens travel along the axis. The old screen leaves as the
new one arrives. Deck files written by Swift Deck name this
effect `slide`; that name still loads.

The new screen travels in over the old one. The old one stays
still.
The new screen grows in as the old one shrinks away.

Viewport.description:
The canvas size of every screen in a design, in px. Screens use px
units against this size; the server scales the result to the frame.

height.description: Canvas height in px, from 320 to 4096.

width.description: Canvas width in px, from 320 to 4096.
